description: HRWare Consulting GmbH & Co. KG is a German company that provides software solutions and consulting services for human resources management. Its services also include payroll processing, accounting, recruitment management, time management, digital personnel files, and employee portal management. HRWare Consulting serves clients in Germany and Switzerland.

description: NOVATIVE SA is a Swiss private company that provides human resources and payroll outsourcing services, as well as HR management software solutions. The company offers cloud-based HR and payroll platforms, including HRMS, payroll software, and workforce management tools such as absence management, time and attendance, and workforce scheduling. Novative also delivers HR analytics, performance management, talent management, and finance services. Its operations serve multinational corporations, banks, industries, services, distribution, hotels, and NGOs in Europe, the USA, and the Middle East. The company is ISO certified and holds additional certifications for security and compliance.

description: ASCIA is a Portuguese company that provides information technology solutions for human resource management, including software for payroll processing, attendance management, employee benefits, recruitment, performance evaluation, and training. HR Campus AG is a Swiss private company that provides human resources consulting, software solutions, and related services. The company offers HR consulting, software implementation, and HR outsourcing, as well as interim management and change management services. Its offerings include HR administration, payroll, travel and expenses management, time and document management, pension fund management, talent management, HR analytics, and external workforce management. HR Campus serves clients in Switzerland and the Romandie region, including SMEs, large enterprises, and public sector organizations.

description: Platfohrm Centhro bv, DBA Platfohrm, is a Belgian company that provides human resources consulting, HR software solutions, and training services for small and medium-sized enterprises. Platfohrm also supports talent management and digital HR processes for its clients.

Globant S.A. is an international IT and software development company engaged in AI-driven software development, business transformation solutions, and cloud services. The London Climate Ready Partnership is a British organization that operates as a service provider in the environmental and sustainability sector, with a focus on climate resilience and adaptation.
